archetype_rationale: Built specifically for dental laboratory management and logistics. Combines clean clinical whites with deep navy structural frame (#06164a) and vibrant dental teal accents (#0097a7), optimized for high-scanability kanban boards, barcode workflows, and mobile driver routes.
js_framework_note: Project uses JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components under React CRA. Guidelines and code snippets are provided for .js / .jsx files.

layout_and_spacing.app_shell: Fixed left sidebar (width 260px desktop, collapsible overlay on mobile) + sticky top header (height 64px, background backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-b z-40)
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6 sm:space-y-8
layout_and_spacing.bento_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
layout_and_spacing.tv_wall_mode: fullscreen dark container (bg-slate-950 text-white p-6 overflow-hidden h-screen flex flex-col grid grid-cols-3 gap-6 auto-refresh)

component_patterns.cards: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border border-border/80 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all p-4 sm:p-5 relative

buttons.primary: bg-[#06164a] hover:bg-[#101c57] text-white shadow-sm font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.teal_action: bg-[#0097a7] hover:bg-[#008392] text-white shadow-sm font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2

component_patterns.status_badges: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border shadow-2xs
component_patterns.barcode_input_bar: relative flex items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#0097a7] p-2 shadow-md focus-within:ring-4 focus-within:ring-[#0097a7]/20
component_patterns.tables: w-full text-left text-sm border-collapse rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border shadow-xs
component_patterns.driver_mobile_card: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 shadow-lg space-y-4

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: Every button, input, select, table row, card action, status badge, and navigation tab MUST include explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='barcode-scan-input', data-testid='case-card-1042', data-testid='start-my-day-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: All text over colored status backgrounds must meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 minimum). Overdue badge uses dark red text on light rose chip.

motion_guidelines.kanban_drag_drop: framer-motion or smooth layout animations with scale-102 during drag
